name: Arcmira
summary: Search API and MCP server over podcasts, interviews and long-form video: transcripts, passages, mentions, sponsors and recommendations, plus monitors.
description: Arcmira indexes spoken long-form media into an entity graph. The REST API (OpenAPI 3.1, "Arcmira API" 1.0.0, about 31 paths) uses Bearer `arc_sk_…` keys; POST /v1/signups issues a free key with the read scope. The hosted MCP server at https://mcp.arcmira.com/mcp supports OAuth (authorization server api.arcmira.com; scopes include read, recommendations:read, monitors:write, trackers:write) or the API key. Credits: Free 1,000/month; Pro $20/month (20,000, 7-day trial); Pro+ $60/month (60,000; needed for commercial intelligence); Ultra $200/month (400,000); extra credits $0.002 each; Enterprise custom. The npm SDK/CLI `arcmira` (0.6.2) is Apache-2.0, but the MCP package in arcmira/mcp is proprietary (UNLICENSED). Operated by Arcmira, Inc. (San Francisco). Submitted by Arcmira via issue #23.

agent_access.notes: MCP: OAuth (protected-resource metadata at mcp.arcmira.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) or Bearer arc_sk_ API key; REST: Bearer API key.
